d:
They're in love. They're ambitious. And somehow, they're still figuring it all out.
Episode 1 of Please Find Attached Season 3 is here!
After years of rooting for Shaurya and Sanya, we finally get to see them navigate a new phase of their relationship, one filled with exciting career goals, big decisions, and all the little moments that make us fall in love with them over and over again.
